reason: The signed date, the late penalty and paying 70% only after I check the work are exactly what I want. But ₹89,000 for our house is about two months of our pension, so I would take the free visit and compare it with the big-brand painting service and our old local painter before I commit to anything.
objection: On a pension, ₹89,000 is a lot for a paint brand that has only just come to Kochi. And ₹2,000 a day off doesn't help much if the crew walks off halfway and my house sits half-done for weeks.
would_change_my_mind: A written quote at the site visit that comes to about ₹70,000 for the house after the founding discount, or seeing a finished Turbolux home near us and hearing from the owner that they finished on the date.
